title: fix(metadata-protocol): a package's rollback, revert or package rollback of its own permission set restores beside another namespace's shipped set
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9BNdBet5uqNbzVw5DWcs1wy)_

Fixes #34401

Clause-②: yes (widening) — a rollback, a commit revert or a package rollback of a package's own permission set N, refused 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` ("provided by a managed package and is sealed") while a package of another namespace ships N, now restores; a delete of that set answers "Deleted permission 'N' (package=P) — it no longer exists." in place of "Customization overlay deleted (package=P) — permission/N reset to artifact default.", with `reset: true` as before; nothing the doors accepted is refused
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：包 crm 发布了权限集 N 时，另一命名空间的包 hr 现在可以把自己的 N 回滚到旧版本、回退改过 N 的提交、或把整个包回滚到更早提交，旧版本会恢复且 hr 的授权生效旧版本；hr 删除自己的 N 时，回执改为「已删除、不再存在」，不再说「重置为制品默认」。
- 为什么改：保存、草稿发布、发布撤销已经按「包 + 名称」判断(#34359),回滚和回退仍只看名称，把 crm 的同名集当成被覆盖的封存基线，误拒了 hr 对自己集合的恢复；删除回执也读同一个只看名称的事实。
- 风险与回滚：风险在恢复写入意图的收窄；它只复用保存门已在用的同一个判定 `isOwnPermissionSetWrite`,凡是覆盖 crm 所发布 N 的恢复(不绑包、绑 crm、绑 crm 的定制配对包、绑 crm 或 fin 同命名空间的包)仍按原来的错误码拒绝。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-class-head.ts`(`restoreWriteFor` 一行收窄，回滚与提交回退共用),`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`(删除回执的同一判定)。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.test.ts`,预期 71 个全部通过，其中 `[#34401]` 一组覆盖两种注册顺序下的恢复、删除回执和全部拒绝对照。
- 需要你做的：评审本次声明的放宽(回滚、提交回退、包回滚三处门，以及删除回执文字)。

## What changes

A permission set is `(package, name)` (ADR-0150 D2/D9). #34359 made the save door, the draft publish and the publish undo judge a write of a package's own set `N` by the package it is addressed to (`isOwnPermissionSetWrite`, `protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`). The per-item rollback and a commit revert's restore limb still handed `restoreWriteFor` the name-wide `isArtifactBacked`, so a restore into `hr`'s own `N`, while `crm` of another namespace ships `N`, was told `override-artifact` and refused by the store's managed seal.

- `restoreWriteFor` (`protocol-class-head.ts`), the one derivation both restore sites share, narrows the `artifactBacked` it receives by `isOwnPermissionSetWrite(engine, type, name, binding)`, where `binding` is the row the restore writes (the rollback's resolved row binding, the revert's commit package). A restore into a package's own set is a runtime-only write, as that package's save is. Every other restore keeps the intent and the pair handling it had. One place covers all three doors: `POST /api/v1/meta/:type/:name/rollback`, `POST /packages/:id/commits/:commitId/revert`, and `POST /packages/:id/rollback`, which reverts commit by commit.
- `deleteMetaItem` (`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`): the two repository-path receipts that claim a code-shipped item sits under the deleted address (the success receipt and the "no row" receipt) read the same verdict at the resolved address. A delete of `hr`'s own `N` answers "Deleted permission 'N' (package=hr) — it no longer exists."; a delete naming `hr` when `hr` holds no `N` answers "No permission 'N' found — nothing to delete.". The delete's write intent is unchanged (the store already admits it; see Acceptance notes).

| Request about `N` (crm ships `N`) | FROM (main) | TO (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| rollback of `hr`'s own `N` to v1 | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, v2 kept | v1 restored; `hr`'s grant confers v1 |
| revert of `hr`'s commit that edited `N` | `N` in `failed[]`, `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` | v1 restored, `failed: []` |
| `rollbackToPackageCommit` to `hr`'s earlier commit | the revert in `failed[]` | v1 restored |
| the same with `crm` AND `fin` shipping `N` | refused | restored |
| delete of `hr`'s own `N` | `reset: true`, "Customization overlay deleted (package=hr) — permission/N reset to artifact default." | `reset: true`, "Deleted permission 'N' (package=hr) — it no longer exists." |
| delete naming `hr`, no `hr` row | "No customization overlay found … already at artifact default." | "No permission 'N' found — nothing to delete." |
| rollback of a row bound to crm / crm's pair | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` | unchanged |
| rollback of a row bound to no package | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` | unchanged |
| rollback of a row bound to a co-owner of crm's (or, with fin shipping, fin's) namespace | 422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` | unchanged |
| revert of a commit of `N` bound to crm / crm's pair | `failed[]` `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` | unchanged |
| revert of a commit of `N` bound to no package / a co-owner | `failed[]` `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` | unchanged |
| delete of crm's pair's customization of `N` | `reset: true`, "… reset to artifact default." | unchanged |

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.test.ts`, the #34226 pin file:

- New top-level describe `[#34401] restoring or deleting a package's own set N beside another namespace's shipped N`, every case in both registration orders: the rollback, the commit revert and the package rollback restore v1 (and `hr`'s grant confers it); `crm` and `fin` both shipping still restores; ten CONTROL cases (5 rollback, 5 revert) assert the `code` and `status` main answered, measured before the fix, and that the active row is untouched; the two delete receipts; a CONTROL that the pair's customization delete still reads as a reset.
- The composition the #34226 describe used (packages, `N`, `composition`, `confers`) moved from inside that describe to module scope, unchanged, so both describes share it. `git diff -w` shows the move as whitespace.
- The file's fake engine (forced change, named): a row of a table other than `sys_metadata` is keyed by its own id, so a second package commit no longer overwrites the first, and the history rows are exposed for the CONTROL rebind. No `findOne`/`update`/`delete` double was added (`check:engine-double-contract` counts unchanged).

## Acceptance notes

- Deviation from comment 6917777398: it asked for `reset: false` on the delete of `hr`'s own `N`. `DeleteMetaItemResponseSchema` defines `reset === true` as "a row was deleted" and `false` as "nothing was removed", so `reset` stays `true` (a row was deleted) and only the receipt text changes. Amended claim 6932622107 records this.
- Not changed: the delete's write intent and `revertCommit`'s removal limb (`isArtifactBacked` alone). Both hand the store `override-artifact` for `hr`'s own `N`, and `assertDeleteAllowed` admits it for a `supportsOverlay` type, so nothing is refused and the change would not be observable. The card names the removal limb as not refused.
- The rollback CONTROL bound to no package answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, and the co-owner CONTROLs answer 422 `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`. Those refusals are judged ahead of the restore, on main as on this branch.

## Verification

<details><summary>FROM on main source, ablations, suites and gates</summary>

- FROM (the new describe on unchanged source, `bdd51769`): 22 failed / 10 passed. Rollback 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`; revert `failed[]` `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`; package rollback failed; delete receipt "reset to artifact default". The CONTROL envelopes were read from this run and pinned.
- TO: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/packaged-permission-set-lock-gate.test.ts`, 71 passed (71).
- Ablation R1 (`restoreWriteFor` narrowing removed, `const overridesShipped = artifactBacked;`): 8 failed / 63 passed. The failures are the rollback, revert, package rollback and two-shipper cases, both orders. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- Ablation D1 (delete receipt narrowing removed): the first attempt replaced the anchor with `;` and was a no-op that `ablation-replace.mjs` refused (replacement count did not move), so no reading. Re-run with a marker replacement: 4 failed / 67 passed, the two delete-receipt cases in both orders. Restored: blob == HEAD.
- The suite resolves `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` to source (`vitest.config.ts` alias), so no rebuild is needed between legs.
- After merging `origin/main`, under `os-verify-lock`, VERDICT command-exit 0: closure build, `metadata-protocol` typecheck, `plugin-security` typecheck, `plugin-security` test (274 files, 6883 passed / 45 skipped), `metadata-protocol` test (346 passed / 9 skipped files, 22968 passed / 45 skipped).
- Derived gate families at head `bf5dccdba2`: 74 derived, 74 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (`dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`). The first pass had 3 exit-3 prerequisites (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` on a shallow clone; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` on an unbuilt workspace). Each re-ran to exit 0 after `git fetch --unshallow` and a full `pnpm build` (VERDICT command-exit 0).

</details>
